source.label: Block-pair kernels on the six-by-five functional board

reviewer: Claude Code with sole fresh-context medium reviewer

claims.summary: Conjecture: for the functional pigeonhole system over F_2 (pigeon axioms 1+sum_j x_ij, hole and functionality axioms, multilinear ring) with n+1 pigeons and n holes, at a proper degree D, K<=D-1, and any set F of monomial errors E with K+deg E<=D, the common kernel {u in V_K: uE in C for E in F} modulo the degree-D closure C equals the common kernel modulo the closure H of the hole and functionality axioms alone, plus C cap V_K. Monomials on one pigeon or one hole lie in H and constrain neither side. Extends conj:functional-kernel-transfer (deg E=1) to monomial errors; via multiplication by x_b, Ann_C(x_a x_b) = mu_b^{-1}(Ann_C^{(2)}(x_a)). Evidence: check:block-pair-kernels.
claims.assessment: Conjecture; evidence check:block-pair-kernels at one size, F_2, K=1, D=3; the sole fresh-context medium reviewer checked its scope and the mu_b reduction.
claims.rationale: A positive excess would be a killer the pigeon axioms add, a joint saving beyond supports; none found.
claims.next_action: Prove it at K=1 by comparing leading forms of a member uE of degree 3.

claims.summary: Exact F_2 computation (block_pairs.py reusing three_quantities.py and tools/pc_closure.py) on the functional pigeonhole system with 6 pigeons and 5 holes at D=3, K=1 (dim V_1=31, C cap V_1 the 6 pigeon axioms): the error sets {x00x11}, {x00x11,x22x33}, {x00x11,x11x22}, {x00x11,x01x10}, {x00x11,x00x22} and {x00x11,x22x33,x34x43} have total excess 0, single excess 0 and joint defect 0, with surviving domain killers modulo C cap V_1 of dimension 16, 8, 11, 15, 11, 4. Controls: the variable set {x00,x11} gives excess 0 as recorded; the linear-axiom positive control gives excess 1. By the S_6 x S_5 symmetry the singleton covers every pair on distinct pigeons and holes.
claims.assessment: Exact computation; the script, masks and controls checked by the sole fresh-context medium reviewer, who recomputed the H-side dimensions by hand; no control runs the degree-2 error path on the C side.
claims.rationale: Tests the head item's block-pair families in a proper closure; no killer beyond the domain model's.

relationships: Extends it from variable errors to monomial errors on distinct pigeons and holes.
Same board and kernel code; its K=2 variable equalities reduce the K=1 monomial case through multiplication by x_b.
Its deg E = 1 case at K=1, recorded there.
